'''Narask''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Narask worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and was a regular patron of the [[Space Monkey Café]], a bar that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. He was an associate of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Selima DeWitt]] and when she went missing, the [[heroes of Cularin]], who had been hired to find her, approached Narask in the Café an asked him some questions about her.

==Personality and traits==
Like many members of his species, Narask detested [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].
